summary: The getUser handler now reads the user id from a different route param, puts the id in its 404 message, and adds a fetchedAt timestamp to the response.

findings.title: Handler reads a route param that does not exist
findings.problem: The route at src/routes/users.js:7 declares the param as :id. The handler destructures userId from req.params, so userId is always undefined.
findings.consequence: findUser(undefined) always returns nothing, so GET /users/:id answers 404 for every user. The error message also says "no user with id undefined".
findings.fix: Read the id param that the route declares.

findings.title: Changed getUser behaviour has no covering test
findings.problem: The change alters the param lookup, the 404 body and the response shape. No test in the repository exercises getUser.
findings.consequence: A test would have caught the broken param lookup before this push.
findings.fix: Add a test for GET /users/:id that checks the found case and the not-found case.
